login.title: Sign In
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account
login.brandTagline: Accounting in Arabic and English, built for accountants
login.brandFooter: A person reviews every draft before it is posted.

ai.title: Optional AI on your own account
ai.desc: Off by default. An admin can turn it on with the organization's own provider account; AI only suggests and never posts.

automation.title: Bills read into drafts
automation.desc: Upload a bill or receipt and it is read into a draft you review. Every posted document has a balanced journal entry.

insights.title: Clear reports
insights.desc: Profit and loss, balance sheet, trial balance and aging reports

security.title: Roles and audit trail
security.desc: Each organization's data is kept apart, permissions follow each person's role, and every change is logged.

register.title: Create Account
register.subtitle: Start your free trial today
register.accountCreatedDescription: Sign in with your new email and password.
register.agreeToTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
register.countryHint: Sets the currency of your books and creates a standard chart of accounts.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email to reset your password
forgotPassword.checkEmail: Check your email for reset instructions
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to reset the password. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes.
forgotPassword.noMail: No email arriving? Ask your organization owner to create a reset link for you from Settings → Team & Roles.

errors.accountInactive: Your account is inactive. Please contact support.
errors.emailExists: An account with this email already exists
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
resetPassword.doneBody: Your password was changed and you were signed out on every device. Sign in with the new password.
resetPassword.invalidBody: The reset link is invalid, already used or expired. Request a new one.
